context.fix_summary: Added check_instance_match/2 guard in get_content/3 (attachments.ex) before the artifact blob read, threaded instance_id through from the router call site. Fix closes a timing side-channel where cross-instance-same-tenant denial cost 2 round-trips vs 1 for cross-tenant/never-issued.

invariants.rationale: get/2 prefix-scoping unchanged (Repo.get(Attachment, id, prefix: prefix)); check_instance_match/2 is pure in-memory struct comparison, issues no Repo call; no migration or schema module introduced. Checked: (a) prefix scoping present, (b) no new table, (c) no tenant_id write path.
S4 not started; no multi-tenant API serialisation surface in this diff.
S5 not started; no Lua/WASM sandbox path in this diff.
grep for System.get_env/password/secret/client_secret/Repo.query in the diff returned 0 hits. No secrets, env vars, logging of sensitive material, or config resolution introduced.

All three denial paths now cost exactly 1 DB round-trip: (1) cross-tenant/never-issued: Repo.get(Attachment) returns nil → {:error, :not_found}, 0 further DB; (2) cross-instance-same-tenant: Repo.get(Attachment) returns row → check_instance_match/2 struct field comparison (zero DB) → {:error, :not_found}, blob read never reached; (3) invalid-id: Ecto.UUID.cast fails → {:error, :invalid_id} before any Repo call. The with-chain order in get_content/3 is confirmed: get/2 → check_instance_match → check_scan_status_clean → Repo.get(Artifact) — instance check provably precedes blob read.
This SECURITY-REVIEWER handoff is the explicit proof-of-scoping record for the modified data-access path. No unreviewed new path merges without this gate.
grep for Repo.query in the diff returned 0 hits. check_instance_match/2 is pure Elixir pattern matching; no raw SQL introduced.
get_content/3 uses a with chain (typed results). check_instance_match/2 returns :ok or {:error, :not_found} — no crash path. No bare {:ok, x} = pattern on external I/O introduced.

specific_findings.finding: Timing fix confirmed via with-chain inspection
specific_findings.detail: Cross-instance-same-tenant denial now exits at check_instance_match/2 (zero DB after the first Repo.get(Attachment)), equalling the 1-round-trip cost of cross-tenant/never-issued denial. The 2-vs-1 round-trip distinguisher described in ISS-0785 is closed.

specific_findings.finding: check_instance_match/2 is pure struct comparison — constant-time not required
specific_findings.detail: Matches %Attachment{instance_id: ^instance_id} pattern. UUIDs are not secrets; an attacker with a valid session already knows their own instance IDs. The sub-microsecond structural comparison is unmeasurable across any real network path and is not a timing signal in INV-5's sense.
All denied branches converge at {:error, :not_found} after 1 round-trip. check_scan_status_clean is also pure struct comparison; blob read only reached on fully-passing happy path.

specific_findings.finding: Defense-in-depth dead branch in instances.ex is sound security posture
specific_findings.detail: The retained {:ok, %Attachment{instance_id: ^instance_id}} match is correctly commented as dead after the ISS-0785 fix. Keeping it ensures that if check_instance_match were ever removed from the context module, the router-layer check would still prevent cross-instance content leakage. No maintenance confusion risk given the explicit comments.
fetch_scoped_attachment_metadata/3 in instances.ex still uses Attachments.get/2 directly (metadata-only, no instance check needed at that layer). get/2 signature is unchanged. No callers broken.
